incident.basin: Gulf of Kutch approaches, Arabian Sea
incident.survey_note: Slick extent digitised from a single VV-polarised acquisition. Extent is a lower bound; thin sheen beyond the delineated edge is below the detection floor.

origin_region.method: Reverse Lagrangian advection, 500-member ensemble, HYCOM surface currents with 3% wind drift

factors.label: Proximity to origin
factors.explanation: Passed within 380 m of the ensemble's modal release point. No other candidate came closer than 1.9 km.

factors.label: Temporal compatibility
factors.explanation: Inside the origin polygon at 21:48 UTC, near the centre of the 6h 45m release window, making way at 4.1 kn — the slowest transit recorded in the box.

factors.label: Trajectory compatibility
factors.explanation: Course over ground sits 6 degrees off the slick's major axis, the tightest angular agreement in the candidate set.

factors.label: Drift consistency
factors.explanation: Reverse advection under HYCOM currents and an 8 m/s north-easterly reconstructs a release path that tracks this vessel's line for 14 km before diverging.

factors.label: AIS/SAR discrepancy
factors.explanation: A 74-minute AIS blackout opens at 20:31 UTC and closes at 21:45 UTC, immediately before the modelled release. No equipment fault was reported to port state control.

factors.label: Proximity to origin
factors.explanation: Crossed the eastern lobe of the origin polygon, but stayed 3.2 km off the modal release point throughout.

factors.label: Temporal compatibility
factors.explanation: In the box at 23:36 UTC, inside the window but in its final third, where ensemble density has already fallen by half.

factors.label: Trajectory compatibility
factors.explanation: Heading differs from the slick's major axis by 34 degrees. Plausible under the observed wind shear, but not corroborating.

factors.label: Drift consistency
factors.explanation: Intersects the backtracked cloud only across its 15th to 85th percentile spread; the median solution misses this track by 2.6 km.

factors.label: AIS/SAR discrepancy
factors.explanation: Continuous AIS at a 3-minute cadence across the whole window, with no course or speed anomaly and no gap to explain.

factors.label: Proximity to origin
factors.explanation: Clipped the northern edge of the polygon only, never entering the high-density core of the ensemble.

factors.label: Temporal compatibility
factors.explanation: Arrived 00:12 UTC, roughly 55 minutes after the modelled release had most likely occurred.

factors.label: Trajectory compatibility
factors.explanation: Runs close to anti-parallel with the slick axis — geometrically consistent, but equally consistent with an unrelated transit.

factors.label: Drift consistency
factors.explanation: Backtracked particles reach this line only in the tail of the ensemble, and only under the strongest wind-drift members.

factors.label: AIS/SAR discrepancy
factors.explanation: Two reporting gaps of 9 and 12 minutes, both within normal dropout for this receiver footprint.

factors.label: Proximity to origin
factors.explanation: Nearest approach 1.9 km north of the polygon boundary; never inside it.

factors.label: Temporal compatibility
factors.explanation: Cleared the area at 19:04 UTC, in the opening hour of the window and well before the ensemble's modal release time.

factors.label: Trajectory compatibility
factors.explanation: Course sits 71 degrees off the slick's major axis. The geometry does not support a discharge along this line.

factors.label: Drift consistency
factors.explanation: Fewer than 12% of ensemble members reach this track, and the post-correction residual stays above 3 km throughout.

factors.label: AIS/SAR discrepancy
factors.explanation: One 28-minute gap at 19:20 UTC, but the vessel had already left the region before the modelled release opened.

factors.label: Proximity to origin
factors.explanation: Closest approach 6.8 km, the furthest of any candidate carried forward.

factors.label: Temporal compatibility
factors.explanation: On scene 4h 10m after the window had closed. Retained only because it crossed the slick itself.

factors.label: Trajectory compatibility
factors.explanation: Cut across the slick after formation, which explains a faint linear disturbance in the scene without implying a source.

factors.label: Drift consistency
factors.explanation: Sits downstream of the reconstructed release, not upstream. No ensemble member connects it to the origin.

factors.label: AIS/SAR discrepancy
factors.explanation: Uninterrupted AIS at a 2-minute cadence, corroborated by both terrestrial and satellite receivers.
